formulas.name: Level curve
formulas.computes: total Level XP to reach a Level, and the Level a total makes
impl: src/data/core-model.js:68-88 (LEVEL_CURVE: first 210, 16 brackets of rise and bend)
SQL hr_level_curve rows + hr_char_level / hr_char_xp_for_level (generated by tools/gen-level-curve.mjs, newest forward file 1016-level-curve-new-player)

formulas.name: Pace contract
formulas.computes: the Level XP an hour a ground must pay at its own Level: 1385 x L^1.274
reads: measured ladder of the open solo grounds (tools/balance-sim/level-pace.json)
formulas.note: not read by the game at runtime: a tuning target that both the curve and the kill XP are fitted to

formulas.name: Combat skill curve
formulas.computes: XP from skill level s to s+1 = floor(15 x s^2 x 1.04^(s-1)), no cap

formulas.name: Capped skill table
formulas.computes: gathering and crafting levels 1 to 99 from a 99-row XP table

formulas.name: Skill XP grant
formulas.computes: credited XP = floor(carry + base x (1 + allXP + combatXP)), base = amount x 0.39 unless the skill is exempt (the rested quantum is gone: P30 cut 2026-11-21)

formulas.name: Weapon skill XP from a blow
formulas.computes: Melee or Ranged XP = damage dealt x 1.5

formulas.name: Defense XP from a monster's blow
formulas.computes: 0.2 x the attacker's Level (raised by the tier's damage dial) per blow aimed at an armored hero, x2 when a shield turns it

formulas.name: Magic XP from a cast
formulas.computes: floor(mana spent x 1.5 x the ability's multiplier)

formulas.name: Training pay
formulas.computes: 30,000 skill XP a settled hour for any skill at any level, 200% while a training item's hours last

formulas.name: Yard fee
formulas.computes: gold an hour = 50 + 6 x the trained skill's level
formulas.note: Tyler ruled 24-8: 100 gold x skill level an hour. Not built on this set

formulas.name: Max HP and max mana
formulas.computes: HP = floor((150 + 10 x (L-1)) x (1000 + 280 x heavy slots / 6) / 1000); mana the same with 100, 10 and 350 x light slots / 6
readBy: monster blow authoring (combat: STAT_FORMULA.blow is a share of this)

formulas.name: Regen from Inner Flame
formulas.computes: regen rate = 1000 + floor(1000 x P / (P + 50)) permille, P the Inner Flame level; Inner Flame XP a bone 15.6

formulas.name: A hero's largest blow (weapon damage scaling)
formulas.computes: maxHit = floor(0.35 x (skill + worn +skill) + 0.6 x worn strength + 2) - floor(monster def x 0.03), then x1.2 on a weakness and x(1 + damage buff)
impl: src/core/combat.js:37-41 (COMBAT_BALANCE names the same numbers, read only by src/shell/wiki-model.js:126)
readBy: kill speed and Level XP an hour

formulas.name: Spell scaling (the spell rule)
formulas.computes: a cast = a permille share of the caster's own largest blow (hitPm rolled half to full, healPm and shieldPm whole) x the rune version's step, never under the row's base floor; Mend heals a share of max HP
formulas.random: a hit rolls half to full

formulas.name: +skill on worn gear
formulas.computes: a worn piece's meleePlus / rangedPlus / magicPlus / defensePlus adds whole skill levels wherever a fight reads the skill

formulas.name: Gear tier ladder
formulas.computes: seven material tiers worn at Levels 1 / 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 88; every stat is a hand-typed array of seven numbers per slot or weapon family
impl: past Dawnsteel only in tools: tools/balance-sim/staged/weapon-line.js:72-75 and armor-line.js:69-72 (Dawnsteel x Level / 110)

formulas.name: Tempering
formulas.computes: a rung adds 1% to blows and heals or takes 1% off what reaches the hero, 5 rungs a track, one ladder per gear tier; a part of a point is one seeded draw

params.gold: tier 2: 62k a track ... tier 7: 1.24M a track, each rung double the last

formulas.random: temperedAmount draws once for the part of a point (the hunt's seeded stream)

formulas.name: Jewelry tiers, perks, Hallmark and reforge
formulas.computes: a perk's size by tier (the largest worn counts once), the roll odds by Crafting level, the Hallmark fee by tier, a reforge at the fee difference

formulas.name: Special attributes and chest gear
formulas.computes: one attribute a piece at a size by gear tier, with a cap across everything worn
impl: src/data/chests.js:143-270 (the Hearth Chest's warmth and stoke odds)

formulas.name: Kill XP split
formulas.computes: hero Level XP = floor(kill XP x mode share / living heroes x party factor / 1000 x scaled-hunt party share x the hero's own multiplier x the under-floor share)

formulas.name: Party class table
formulas.computes: permille of a kill shared by the living heroes, by party size and classes held; a hero alone 1150

formulas.name: Run ground pay
formulas.computes: a Tower kill pays each hero the hours table's share of its own Level over refKillsHead x the depth ratio at the floor's gap x payPm x the room's share, split evenly (lane/tower-boss-formula)

formulas.name: Under-floor Level share
formulas.computes: a seat under the ground's floor AND under 66.7% of the party's top Level keeps floor(1000 x (Level / (top x 0.667))^2) permille of its share

formulas.name: Difficulty tier dials
formulas.computes: Dangerous and Deadly: pull 8, damage x1.17 / x1.33, HP x1.10 / x1.15, Level XP a kill x1.10 / x1.25, with per-ground rows

formulas.name: Session mode share
formulas.computes: the Tower and the Catacombs pay 37.5% of a kill's Level XP and a death there costs nothing

formulas.name: XP weekend
formulas.computes: +25% Level XP a kill for 72 hours every 14 days; live rows add, never past +50%

formulas.name: Death cost
formulas.computes: Level XP lost = floor(total Level XP x 0.06 x the mode's share); each combat skill loses floor(0.06 x its progress into its level)

formulas.name: Blessings
formulas.computes: 1, 2 or 3 held cut a death's loss by 25 / 50 / 75%; price = 0 under Level 30, else base + perLevel x (Level - 30); a death uses them up

formulas.name: Rested bank
formulas.computes: CUT 2026-11-21 (FB-2, 1040-rested-bank-cut.sql; the sitting S-9 C): no rested bank. It was one charge every 6 minutes to a cap of 80 (120 with the Library), a spent charge a flat quantum of at most 1,600 XP
formulas.removed: 2026-11-21, FB-2: src/core/rested.js and hr-accrue/accrue-rested.js deleted, player_state.rested_xp and rested_at dropped (1040-rested-bank-cut.sql)

formulas.name: Perk XP channels
formulas.computes: allXP and combatXP sum from rooms, renown, buffs and a companion; permanent sources are held to +20%; a companion's bonus = base x (1 + 0.05 x (level - 1)) and is added after the cap

formulas.name: Level XP a kill (input)
formulas.computes: 1.436 x L^0.4 per HP point of the monster, at least 2.534, x a floor fit (0.67 to floor 8, 1 at 32) x the ground's own XP fit (0.76 to 1.22)

formulas.name: Tower and Catacomb floors
formulas.computes: a floor's monsters are the stat formula at Level = floor, never past floor 300; past floor 100 blows grow 1.2% a floor, compounding

formulas.name: Luck bar (ruled, not in the game)
formulas.computes: rank n costs 100 x n^2 Luck; rank is the percent on Rare rows, far stop 100

formulas.name: Gear worn by Level
formulas.computes: every piece of equipment names a hero Level as its requirement

formulas.name: Reference hero (projection)
formulas.computes: the skill, Defense and accuracy a career hero holds at each Level; monsters' aim and evasion are written against it; past Level 1,000 a straight line on its last two rows

formulas.name: Skill lines (simulator projection)
formulas.computes: the skills the balance simulator gives a hero at a Level; past the measured line a straight line on its last ten Levels
formulas.note: simulation only, an approximation of P03
